title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第七轮：场景词汇穿插问答与横屏一屏学习
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round seven: contextual dialogue and landscape lesson fit

purpose.zh: 缩短从进入生活口语到首次一问一答的距离，并让横屏学员不必滚动才能看到场景操作。
purpose.en: Reach the first exchange sooner and keep the scene and its actions together in a landscape learner viewport.

zh: 在已有十组店员与学员问答之间均匀穿插场景词；首组问答在最多两张词卡后出现，保留看图、听音、选答和原有十组题目。
词卡和对话继续共用已验证的生活口语播放器与慢速语音控制；词卡提示改为准确说明正在学习场景词。
学习位置使用新版本 Cookie，避免旧课程顺序保存的数字使学员恢复到错误的词句。
横屏短视口自动缩小场景、词图、文字与控件间距，使示范画面、提示和操作按钮在同一屏可见；舞台使用旧版 WebKit 可识别的明确像素高度与上限，竖屏布局不变。
en: Interleave scene words among the existing ten staff–learner exchanges. The first exchange appears after at most two word cards while preserving picture, audio, reply choices, and all ten authored pairs.
Keep the verified Everyday Speaking player and slow-speech control; label word steps accurately as scene-word learning.
Version the resume cookie so an index saved for the old sequence cannot reopen the wrong word or dialogue turn.
Compact the scene, word picture, text, and controls in short landscape viewports with explicit stage pixel heights and caps supported by older WebKit, leaving portrait layouts unchanged.

zh: 影响生活口语的初级、中级和高级场景顺序及横屏播放器布局，包括预构建日语咖啡店、食品店以及已审核或动态生成的对话；不改变词图、价格、会员权限、成绩或支付。
en: Affects Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced Everyday Speaking deck order and landscape layout, including prebuilt Japanese cafe and grocery scenes and reviewed or generated dialogue; picture assets, prices, entitlements, scores, and checkout are unchanged.

zh: 在现有组卡函数中调整词汇和成对问答的编排；新增跨场景行为测试。使用现有播放器 CSS 的横屏高度规则缩小媒体舞台、词图和控件，不复制另一套播放器。
en: Adjust the existing deck assembly with cross-scene behavioral coverage. Add landscape-height rules to the existing player CSS for the media stage, word picture, and controls; no parallel player is introduced.

zh: 完整测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、生产构建、敏感信息扫描及 WebKit 中英多尺寸布局检查作为本轮发布门槛；生产 Chrome 访客流程在确切部署版本上线后复测。
en: Full tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, production build, sensitive-data scan, and bilingual WebKit viewport checks are release gates; the anonymous production Chrome flow is retested on the exact deployed version.

zh: Max 角色导师仍独立关闭，待普通付费测试用户的真实端到端验收；尚未审核的语言对话继续显示内容不可用，而不会教错误翻译。
en: The Max role tutor remains independently gated until real ordinary paid-member acceptance. Unreviewed language dialogues continue to show unavailable content rather than teaching mismatched translations.

zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属教学编排改进，复用本地生活口语组卡、播放器与测试，不迁移其他站点代码或数据。
en: This is SmartLingo-specific lesson sequencing, reusing its local deck builder, player, and tests without migrating another site's code or data.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，可恢复上一成功提交；旧进度 Cookie 与新版键分离，不必修改数据库。
rollback.en: Revert to the prior successful commit if needed. The prior progress cookie remains separate from the versioned key; no database rollback is required.
